title: Exclude the seven paired BIT packet-971 exchanges at arbitrary strict clocks
body:
All seven legal same-grade paired receiver exchanges fail across 16,216 classified sender/receiver timing cells within the one-pulse model. Six have timing-independent first-reader deficits. The common-receiver pair fails protected output parity.
